what_this_is: the CI acceptance harness exercised end to end with NO deployment and NO model call, against local stand-ins for the API and the Kudu VFS. The 12 evidence records were produced by the REAL production orchestration (plan_shadow_wiring) replaying the frozen run-8 payloads, so they are the shape the deployed recorder writes.
why_it_matters: it establishes that a green workflow means something and that a red one fires: the same harness, the same manifest, only the evidence differs between the two runs below

gates_proved_to_fail_closed.no_credentials: exit 2, refused before anything was asked
gates_proved_to_fail_closed.unreachable_host: exit 2, stopped at provenance, 0 questions asked
gates_proved_to_fail_closed.unreadable_sink: exit 2, stopped at the phase 2 gate, 0 questions asked — no model call can be spent on a run that could not adjudicate
gates_proved_to_fail_closed.pre_existing_records: records already in the sink at stage 2 are excluded by correlation id, so a re-run cannot adjudicate the previous run's evidence
